preview.yaml:
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: api-service-cilium
    namespace: default
spec:
    egress:
        - toEndpoints:
            - matchLabels:
                k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: kube-system
                k8s:k8s-app: kube-dns
          toPorts:
            - ports:
                - port: "53"
                  protocol: UDP
              rules:
                dns:
                    - matchPattern: '*'
        - toEndpoints:
            - matchLabels:
                k8s:app: postgres
                k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: data
          toPorts:
            - ports:
                - port: "5432"
                  protocol: TCP
    endpointSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app: api-service
    ingress:
        - fromEndpoints:
            - matchLabels:
                k8s:app: frontend
                k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: default
          toPorts:
            - ports:
                - port: "8443"
                  protocol: TCP
